name: odoo-tools
description: Unified Odoo tooling for Claude: an MCP server (primary) plus a CLI fallback, covering Community, Enterprise and online instances across Odoo versions 10-19 with an automatic cross-version compatibility layer.

odoo_url.title: Odoo URL
odoo_url.description: Scheme and host of your Odoo instance, e.g. https://my-company.odoo.com (no trailing path).

odoo_db.title: Odoo database
odoo_db.description: Database name (Settings, or visible in the login URL).

odoo_login.title: Odoo login
odoo_login.description: The login (usually an email) of the Odoo user the server acts as. Prefer a least-privilege user.

odoo_api_key.title: Odoo API key
odoo_api_key.description: Odoo 14+: Preferences > Account Security > New API Key. Leave empty on Odoo < 14 and fill the password instead.

odoo_password.title: Odoo password (Odoo < 14 only)
odoo_password.description: Only for Odoo 10-13, which have no API keys. Leave empty when you set an API key.

odoo_readonly.title: Read-only mode
odoo_readonly.description: When on, the server refuses every write/delete/Studio tool before touching Odoo.
